plan.headline: Your 7 stories are done and one interview is booked — but you haven't contacted a single firm this week.
plan.status: You finished all 7 STAR stories with strong grades (mostly 4–5/5) and you're interviewing at Harborline Logistics on Saturday, with Northmere's deadline still three weeks out. What's missing is everything that turns prep into applications: your outreach details (signature, hours, start date) aren't set, you haven't taken the SQL/Python skills check, and you've made zero contacts this week against a goal of 5 a day. This week is about unblocking email — fill in outreach details, clear the two overdue/due network notes, and get your first real outbound batch out the door before Saturday.

tasks.title: Send the overdue thank-you note to Priya Shah at Harborline Logistics
tasks.why: It was due 2026-10-12 and it's your warmest link into the company you interview with on Saturday.

tasks.title: Follow up with Marcus Bell at Brightquill Learning
tasks.why: Due tomorrow (2026-10-22) — Brightquill is your only live application besides Harborline.

tasks.title: Fill in your outreach details: signature, weekly hours, start date
tasks.why: Every cold email, follow-up and thank-you the app writes pulls from this card — nothing sends properly until it's set.

tasks.title: Prep for the Harborline analytics manager interview on 2026-10-24
tasks.why: Three days out and no company prep exists yet — build tailored questions around logistics analytics.

tasks.title: Take the SQL and Python skills check
tasks.why: You're applying to data analyst roles with no graded technical baseline yet — this shows where you'd fail a screen.

tasks.title: Contact 5 new analytics/BI internship targets

plan.encouragement: Your prep is genuinely ahead of most sophomores — the only thing standing between you and offers now is hitting send.
